summary: Recommends that the control word always be used with Ethernet pseudowires. RFC 4448 made it optional, and without it an Ethernet packet can be mistaken for IP by a label switching router, possibly causing the wrong load-balancing path to be chosen.

eli5.summary: A package without a label may be mistaken for something else and sent the wrong way. Adding the label stops that.

questions: why use control word in ethernet pw
